doc: The knowledge file in XML, with CRLF endings and a comment: reading, then one step for every kind of edit, each with its exact splices, then undo back to the input. An element left without children closes itself again, and its first child opens it (as in mindmap-nodes).

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
A new property goes after the last property, its keys in the binding's order; unset keys are left out.
